summary: Shows the execution order of the car/wheel/tire/brake example and explains `allow_duplicates: true` must be set on the dependency role (tire, brake), not on the role listing it. Deduplication happens only per play.
questions: Where do I set allow_duplicates for a role dependency, on the parent or the dependency?
Do roles get deduplicated across different plays?
What order do nested dependencies with different parameters run in?

answer_card.title: allow_duplicates with dependencies
answer_card.answer_md:
Resulting order for `car` -> `wheel` (n=1..4) -> `tire`, `brake`:
```text
tire(n=1)
brake(n=1)
wheel(n=1)
tire(n=2)
brake(n=2)
wheel(n=2)
...
car
```
Set `allow_duplicates: true` in the `meta/main.yml` of the role listed **under** `dependencies` (here `tire` and `brake`), not the role that lists them. `wheel` doesn't need it because each instance has different parameters.

Deduplication happens only at the play level, so separate plays in the same playbook may rerun the roles.
